title: A Unified Local Light-shifts Encoding For Solving Optimization Problems on a Rydberg Annealer
summary: Combinatorial optimization problems play a central role in computer science with many real world applications. A number of relevant problems remain computationally difficult to solve as they lie in the NP-hard complexity class. We present a unified framework for solving such optimization problems represented in the quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) formalism, namely two-SAT, XOR-SAT, mixed-two-XOR-SAT, set packing, quadratic assignment, binary clustering, and protein folding, by expanding the domain of applications of \textit{PRR, 6(2), 023031}.
